decisions.why: Used node_modules/.bin/tsx --test instead of node --import tsx/esm --test to stay Node 18 compatible per okx-trade-mcp-rules skill (Node-18 compat rule)
--test-timeout=30000 (30s) chosen: per issue spec; Node 18.7+ supports this flag
AbortSignal.timeout(5000) on loopback fetch: 5s is ample for 127.0.0.1 connections; fires only when a proxy routes traffic through an unreachable host
File-scope before/after added as a redundant outer safety net; per-describe hooks continue to manage their own scenario-specific env independently
CHANGELOG entries under Fixed (not Added) since this is a CI reliability fix, not a user-facing feature
